source.normative: Design.md (owner-authored, not modified by this pass)
source.note: Palette, type and component rules are Design.md's. The three supporting tones (Oat Paper, Cocoa Night, Toffee Ink) were introduced by the landing page and accepted by the owner on 2026-09-28; see Design.md 4.1.1. Entries still marked DERIVED IN BUILD are build values not yet in Design.md.

cocoa.usage: Design.md primary dark. Headings, body text, primary button slab, masthead link, dark fields. CSS --cocoa.

oat.usage: Design.md primary light. In the build: text and button fill on dark posters (--oat). Not used as the page ground; see oat-photo.

toffee.usage: Design.md primary warmth. In the build only as a 12% wash on the sharing poster (--toffee-wash); never as text (3.65:1 on the page ground).

leaf.usage: Design.md botanical accent. In the build only as a 20% wash behind the allergen panel (--leaf-wash).

gold.usage: Design.md joy accent, held to a glint: focus-ring outline, link underline on hover, text selection at 45%.

oat-photo.usage: Accepted by the owner 2026-09-28 (Design.md 4.1.1). Oat Milk re-sampled from the photography's paper so photo edges vanish; the page ground, masthead bar and pinned-scene ground. 11.58:1 under Cocoa Hearth.

cocoa-deep.usage: Accepted by the owner 2026-09-28 (Design.md 4.1.1). Darker Cocoa Hearth: primary button hover, closing poster and footer field, photo scrims (rgb 42 25 20), selection text. 13.78:1 under Oat Milk.

toffee-ink.usage: Accepted by the owner 2026-09-28 (Design.md 4.1.1). Darkened Date Toffee for readable text: the pinned-scene subline. 5.03:1 on oat-photo, where Date Toffee itself is 3.65:1.

line.usage: Cocoa Hearth at 14% for fine rules (facts divider). Within Design.md's 8-16% tint rule.

leaf-wash.usage: Pistachio Leaf at 20%, calm panel behind the allergen statement. Within Design.md's 12-24%.

toffee-wash.usage: Date Toffee at 12%, warm ground of the sharing poster. Within Design.md's 10-20%.

shadows.name: button-rest
shadows.purpose: Soft ambient lift under the cocoa button slab.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover: slightly deeper ambient shadow with the Cocoa Hearth Deep fill.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Butter Gold ring backed by a Cocoa Hearth halo, so gold is never the only focus indicator (Design.md 12.1). On dark fields the halo is Cocoa Hearth Deep.

shadows.name: photo-scrim
shadows.purpose: DERIVED IN BUILD. Cocoa-deep scrim under Oat Milk text on dark photo posters; mobile variant runs top-down (0.82 to 0.2).

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Button and link state transitions; inside Design.md's 180-350ms.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Poster headline entrance. 10ms over Design.md's 350ms ceiling.

motion.name: push-in
motion.purpose: Slow settle of each poster photograph on arrival. Longer than Design.md's 180-350ms transition band; a deliberate ambient move.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 0.01ms; pinned scene shows the open state statically

narrative.overview: Palm and Pod should look like something deeply pleasurable made by someone who cares what goes into it. Every visual should balance three signals: Indulgence, Care, Ingredient honesty. The order matters. Lead with desire, support it with care, and close with proof.

rules.name: Recommended balance
rules.body: 50–65% Oat Milk or warm photography; 20–30% Cocoa Hearth; 10–15% Date Toffee or Pistachio Leaf; no more than 5% Butter Gold.

rules.name: Butter Gold as glint
rules.body: Butter Gold should behave like a glint of warmth, not a background color.

rules.name: Fraunces and Manrope roles
rules.body: Fraunces for brand expression and headings; Manrope for body, facts, labels, navigation and buttons.

rules.name: Low-opacity borders over shadow
rules.body: Prefer a subtle Cocoa Hearth border at low opacity over a heavy shadow.

dos: Cocoa Hearth text on Oat Milk
Oat Milk text on Cocoa Hearth
Cocoa Hearth text on Butter Gold
Use Butter Gold for a focus ring or small active detail, not as the only focus indicator.
donts: Pure black as a replacement for Cocoa Hearth
Butter Gold text on Oat Milk
High-saturation green, orange, pink, purple, or primary colors
Do not bounce, wobble, pulse, or use candy-like elastic motion.
Do not set emotional headlines in all caps.
